h1: Custom Gift Sets & Bundles with Patch
metaTitle: Custom Gift Sets with Patch | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom gift sets & bundles with patch from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for corporate gifts, employee recognition, and promotional events.
introHtml: Custom gift sets and bundles with a sewn or embroidered patch add a tactile, premium feel that standard printed sets can't match. Whether you're building a company swag kit for new hires or a promotional bundle for a trade show, the patch serves as a durable, high-visibility branding element that stands out on backpacks, jackets, or hats. Choose from canvas totes, branded notebooks, or drinkware combinations, all finished with a custom patch that reinforces your logo or message.
heroAltText: Custom gift set and bundle with embroidered patch featuring company logo on canvas tote bag
